mapper.sql: select v.visitor_id, v.token_hash, v.channel_code, v.content_code, v.client_platform, cast(v.profile as text) as profile, v.app_user_id, v.last_seen_time, v.del_flag, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, v.remark from abr_visitor v
mapper.insert: insert into abr_visitor (token_hash, channel_code, content_code, client_platform, profile, last_seen_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{tokenHash}, coalesce(#{channelCode}, 'direct'), coalesce(#{contentCode}, ''), coalesce(#{clientPlatform}, ''), '{}'::jsonb, now(), '0', '', now())
mapper.update: update abr_visitor set last_seen_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and (last_seen_time is null or last_seen_time < now() - interval '10 minutes')
update abr_visitor set profile = coalesce(profile, '{}'::jsonb) || cast(#{patch} as jsonb), update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
update abr_visitor set profile = '{}'::jsonb, update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
